source.title: Call for Applications - WFC Leader (August 2024)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Financial Committee (WFC) Leader, noting that this is now separated from the Treasurer role. The WFC Leader is responsible for managing the WFC Members and the day-to-day oversight of the WCA’s revenue programs (e.g., dues) and funding programs. The WCA Treasurer is responsible for the WCA’s overall finances, which include financial reporting, controls, and managing the relationship with external accountants.


Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are: 

* Solid knowledge of the structure and workflow inside the WCA
* Experience on financial matters, especially bookkeeping and tax filing
* Proficiency in English
* A reasonable daily availability to deploy the duties
* Team management capabilities

<!-- break -->

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until August 21th, 2024, 23:59 UTC.** Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
3. Ambitions as the WFC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WFC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2024.6.](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.6%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf)

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2024.0. ](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)

Please note that the WCA Board have appointed Ed Hollingdale as an interim Leader of the Finance Committee for a period of up to 3 months, expiring November 7th, 2024.

translation.title: WCA 财务委员会招募负责人（2024 年 8 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命一位新的财务委员会（WFC）负责人。请注意，该岗位现已与司库岗位分开。WFC 负责人负责管理委员会成员，日常监督 WCA 的收入项目（如会费）和资助项目；WCA 司库则负责 WCA 的整体财务，包括财务报告、财务内控，以及与外部会计师的合作。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 7 小时处理委员会工作。我们希望申请人具备：

* 熟悉 WCA 的组织结构和内部工作流程。
* 有财务工作经验，尤其是记账和报税。
* 英语熟练。
* 每天能安排适当时间处理事务。
* 团队管理能力。

<!-- break -->

申请从即日起开放，**截止时间为 2024 年 8 月 21 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请私下将材料发送至董事会助理团队（assistants@worldcubeassociation.org），并抄送 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WCA 财务委员会负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WFC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2024.6](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.6%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 议案 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 5 节，通过投票选出并公布新负责人。

请注意，WCA 董事会已任命 Ed Hollingdale 为财务委员会代理负责人，任期最长 3 个月，于 2024 年 11 月 7 日届满。
